team.name: Daniel Tan
team.bio:
With over 40 years of experience across construction, manpower, and dormitory industries, our Founder & Chairman brings unparalleled industry knowledge and a wealth of established relationships.

As a mentor and strategic advisor, he continues to guide the leadership team and shape the company’s long-term growth and direction.

team.name: Alexander Wu
team.bio:
With over 10 years of industry experience, Alexander drives the company’s business expansion and strategic growth, overseeing new developments from deal-making and acquisition through planning, construction, licensing, and opening.

His hands-on leadership ensures each project is delivered seamlessly and successfully.

team.name: Janell Tan
team.bio:
With 10 years at the company, Janell drives smooth day-to-day operations across our dormitories and hostels, ensuring high standards and continuous improvement.

Her strong people-management skills and deep connection with staff keep operations efficient, responsive, and seamless.

team.name: Tiffany Tan
team.bio:
Tiffany oversees the company’s financial management with precision, ensuring accuracy and sound financial processes.

Beyond finance, she supports talent acquisition and employee benefits, contributing to a positive workplace and the company’s continued success.

team.name: Alan Lin
team.bio:
Alan drives business development and growth, from sourcing new opportunities and partnerships to expanding into new markets.

He played a key role in our backpackers’ hostel expansion and leads marketing initiatives to maximise dormitory occupancy, combining strong BD instincts with a marketer’s mindset to drive growth.

team.name: Rachel Tan
team.bio:
Rachel brings tech industry experience in inbound sales and business development at HubSpot. Since joining D Wall, she has taken a key role in overseeing our newly opened dormitory, focusing on occupancy, business development, and client relationships.

Her sales expertise and strong relationship-building skills help drive occupancy and lasting client partnerships.

team.name: Ryan Tan
team.bio:
Ryan oversees day-to-day operations and improvement initiatives at TWL Hospitality while pursuing a degree in hospitality.

He brings a fresh perspective to team management, social media marketing, and guest experience, while securing partnerships with businesses such as DOPA and Anytime Fitness to provide added value for guests.
